For each agenda item, a limit of one document per company was applied. RAN5 aspects were introduced via individual company CRs. Some papers were merged without live presentation, but many were discussed in detail. A number of pCRs were selected as the basis for further email discussions. The aim was to consolidate all agreed input into a single pCR per agenda item in Clause 4 of TR 21.802.
